def _build_replicated_block_table(
        self,
        dcp_block_table: torch.Tensor,
        block_table_cols: int,
        num_reqs: int,
        num_actual_tokens: int,
        seq_lens: torch.Tensor,
        common_attn_metadata,
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        """Build replicated block table for DCP indexer path."""
        total_cp_size = self._total_cp_size
        device = self.device

        # replicated_col_idx: column indices for replicated view
        replicated_col_idx = torch.arange(
            block_table_cols,
            dtype=torch.long,     # ← long对列索引超量（int32足），意见1核心问题
            device=dcp_block_table.device,
        )

        # ... intermediate logic ...

        # req_indices & query_lens: repeat_interleave for token-level mapping
        query_lens = seq_lens[:num_reqs].to(device=self.device)
        req_indices = torch.repeat_interleave(
            torch.arange(num_reqs, dtype=torch.long, device=self.device),
            query_lens.to(device=self.device, dtype=torch.long),
        )[:num_actual_tokens]

        # positions: token positions for DCP remapping
        positions = common_attn_metadata.positions[:num_actual_tokens].to(
            device=self.device,
            dtype=torch.long,
        )
        return replicated_col_idx, req_indices, positions
